Did you know? Everything we do leaves a carbon footprint — sending an email, eating a meal, or streaming a video all contribute to CO₂ emissions. Even a single cheeseburger can produce CO₂! BACK Cars release carbon dioxide, a greenhouse gas that contributes to climate change. Choosing to walk, bike, or take public transport helps reduce our carbon footprint Transportation The food we eat also impacts the environment. Locally grown and plant-based foods have a lower carbon footprint compared to processed and imported goods. Food Have you heard? We can reduce our carbon footprint by using public transport, saving energy, reducing waste, choosing sustainable food, and planting trees. nnnn
